reason: This text is the burning bush narrative (Exodus 3) where God reveals to Moses that He has heard the cry (צַעֲקַת) of the Israelites. However, the context explicitly attributes this cry to Egyptian oppression ('הַלַּחַץ אֲשֶׁר מִצְרַיִם לֹחֲצִים אֹתָם' - the oppression with which Egypt presses upon them), not to complaints about Hebrew leaders. God is responding to suffering under foreign bondage and commanding Moses to lead a liberation exodus, not addressing internal leadership grievances among the Hebrew people.
